verdict.rationale: Runloop's first-party snapshot docs say a Devbox's disk state can be saved and new Devboxes created from it. They name rollback to a known-good point and fan-out into multiple attempts as use cases, which covers both restore and fork. Suspend/resume is a separate feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of snapshot API/CLI depth (listing, deleting, limits), and memory/process-state capture beyond disk state.

support.subject: As a developer, I can snapshot a sandbox and later restore or fork new sandboxes from that snapshot

citations.quote: Snapshots can be used to save the current disk state of a Devbox, and to create new Devboxes from a previously saved state.
Roll back to a known good point in time. Perform fan-out and attempt multiple approaches to a code change.
Saved diskstates from existing for devboxes for re-use & branching
